title: Preflight Handoff Controller with capacity gating and model fallback selection
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Background: As part of the Smart Routing Policies initiative we need an orchestrator that performs preflight checks before executing a cross-region handoff. The goal is to avoid blind failovers that cause large latency spikes or error rates by enforcing a capacity+latency quorum, verifying model compatibility, and performing targeted cache warmups. This ticket implements the Preflight Handoff Controller (PHC): a control-plane component that coordinates probes, gate decisions, and an ordered sequence of actions for a regional handoff.

Scope: PHC responsibilities include: (1) running parallel health probes across candidate target pools (latency, error, available GPU slots, KV cache hit approximations); (2) computing a gating decision using weighted thresholds (capacity, p95/p99 latency, error rate, model variant compatibility); (3) initiating prewarm operations (KV seed, small synthetic requests, metadata sync) where needed; (4) orchestrating a staged traffic cutover with circuit-breaker rollbacks; (5) publishing a structured handoff trace into Jaeger and the Console rollout timeline.

Out of scope: full autopilot traffic rebalancer, long-term model retraining, billing changes. Those are separate tickets.
acceptance_criteria: PHC exposes an API endpoint /v1/handoff/preview that returns a deterministic gating decision plus metrics snapshot for a candidate region in <150ms
Staged failover simulation: under lab load (synthetic RPS matching production 90th percentile) PHC can complete a preflight and initiated cutover within 10s with a rollback-safe plan
Observed failover QoS: when performing an orchestrated handoff in staging, 95% of requests experience <2x baseline p99 and error spike does not exceed 2 percentage points above baseline

Model compatibility: PHC evaluates model variant families and refuses a handoff if the target only supports incompatible tokenizers or incompatible sequence-length profiles; compatibility checks are logged and surfaced in the Console

Telemetry: PHC writes a structured handoff event with fields (origin_region, target_region, gating_score, prewarm_actions, chosen_model_variant, outcome) to the existing rollout-events topic and the Console timeline
Canary mode: a canary rollout path with 5% traffic handled by the target must pass 3 consecutive 30s windows of p95 and error checks before ramping further
updates: 2026-02-12: Design review with Runtime and Console teams. Decided to reuse the existing rollout-events topic and add a lightweight handoff trace schema instead of introducing a separate topic (Marcus)

2026-02-18: Implemented gating scoring prototype in runtime repo (PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/832). Prototype uses capacity_score (available_gpus / requested_qps) and latency_penalty (p99 / target_p99). Feedback: add KV-cache readiness as a separate dimension (Li Wei)

2026-02-24: Added prewarm step to initiate KV cache fill using zero-cost prefix requests and small sequence seeds. Verified prototype reduces first-request p99 by ~35% in staging for common prompts (Sofia)

2026-03-01: Integration tests added to the CI staging harness that simulate region outage and assert PHC's rollback triggers when gating_score < 0.6. Two flaky tests observed under heavy concurrent simulation; root cause is probe timeouts (investigating) (Marcus)

2026-03-05: Probe timeout params tuned from 3s -> 1.2s for p50 probe path; reduced end-to-end preflight time by 30% in local load tests. Still need to validate against production-like traffic mix (next: loadrunner run)
comments: Asha Patel (2026-02-12): Important to ensure the PHC does not become a single point of failure — plan for local cached decisions if the control plane is degraded.

Li Wei (2026-02-18): For model compatibility we should call into the model-catalog service and validate tokenizer hashes + qkv layout metadata. If incompatible, PHC should surface a suggested compatible fallback variant when available.
Sofia Alvarez (2026-02-24): Prewarm strategy matters for memory-constrained pools; we should support a low-memory prewarm mode that seeds only KV slices for active sessions rather than full context.
Marcus Nguyen (2026-03-01): Observed intermittent probe timeouts in CI; proposed change to use parallel fast probes with reduced payload and fall back to full probes only on positive gating paths.
Security (2026-03-03): PHC API must enforce caller RBAC. Marking security_review_required=true and adding encryption-in-transit requirements for prewarm payloads.
